lineup:C:4035538:w1.title: David Montgomery had the game you wanted, on your bench
lineup:C:4035538:w1.text: James Cook III got the Week 1 start at running back. David Montgomery, stuck on your bench, had the better game by a mile. Worth remembering before you set this lineup again.

pos:K1:FLEX6.title: Your kicker's an MVP. Your flex spot is not.
pos:K1:FLEX6.text: Best kicker production in the league, worst flex production, the wild-card spot where anyone can start. If you're hunting a waiver add, that's exactly where to look.

proj:under:3040151:4035538.title: George Kittle, defying projections like it's a hobby
proj:under:3040151:4035538.text: Kittle's been outscoring his number since Week 1, apparently just to spite the algorithm. Montgomery's doing the opposite, quietly losing the argument every week.

lineup:B:4259545:w1.title: D'Andre Swift made your flex decision look rough
lineup:B:4259545:w1.text: Week 1, Emeka Egbuka got the flex nod while D'Andre Swift torched it from your bench. Swift's the one that got loose.

pos:WR1:K8.title: Elite receivers, an afterthought at kicker
pos:WR1:K8.text: Your wide receivers rank first in the league. Your kicker ranks dead last. Easiest fix on the roster: stream a new leg off the waiver wire.

proj:over:4241389:4360248.title: CeeDee Lamb is bullying his own projection
proj:over:4241389:4360248.text: Lamb's been blowing past his number weekly, no mercy. Kyle Pitts Sr. keeps falling short of his, the quieter kind of letdown.

pos:RB3:QB8.title: Your backfield's solid. Quarterback isn't.
pos:RB3:QB8.text: Running back ranks third in the league. Quarterback ranks last. That's the spot to watch on the waiver wire or in a trade.

proj:under:4258173:4572680.title: Nico Collins didn't get ESPN's memo
proj:under:4258173:4572680.text: Collins keeps clearing his number with room to spare. Tucker Kraft's stuck under his, the tight end equivalent of running out the clock.

lineup:D:4248528:w1.title: Christian Watson, still waiting on your bench
lineup:D:4248528:w1.text: Week 1, Quinshon Judkins got the flex spot while Christian Watson quietly stacked points behind him. Not the last time this happens this season, so maybe it's time to trust him.

pos:TE1:RB7.title: Tight end carries this team. Running back doesn't.
pos:TE1:RB7.text: Your tight end production ranks first in the league. Running back ranks near the bottom. If a trade or waiver add is coming, that's the spot.

proj:under:4361370:3929630.title: Chris Olave's quietly out-earning the hype
proj:under:4361370:3929630.text: Olave keeps topping his projection without much fuss. Saquon Barkley's the one coming up short, which is not the plotline anyone paid for.

lineup:C:4432665:w3.title: Brock Bowers made Maya's tight end call look brutal
lineup:C:4432665:w3.text: Week 3, Dalton Schultz got the start at tight end while Brock Bowers quietly dropped a monster day on the bench. Rough one, even for the person who built this site.

pos:QB2:K7.title: Strong at quarterback, shaky at kicker
pos:QB2:K7.text: Maya's quarterback production ranks second in the league. Her kicker ranks near the bottom. An easy fix sitting on the waiver wire.

proj:over:4685472:4596448.title: Tetairoa McMillan is making Maya look like a genius
proj:over:4685472:4596448.text: McMillan's been blowing past his projection, carrying a lineup Maya definitely didn't draft for this. Bucky Irving's the drag, stuck under his number most weeks.

pos:RB1:WR8.title: Running back is carrying this roster
pos:RB1:WR8.text: Your running backs rank first in the league. Your receivers rank dead last. That gap is exactly where a waiver add or a trade should go to work.

proj:over:4430737:4870795.title: Kyren Williams, projections' least favorite guy
proj:over:4430737:4870795.text: Williams keeps blowing past his number like it insulted him personally. Makai Lemon's landing under his more often than not.

pos:QB1:RB8.title: Quarterback is elite. Running back is a problem.
pos:QB1:RB8.text: Your quarterback production ranks first in the league. Running back ranks dead last. That's the spot to attack on the waiver wire or in a trade.

pos:WR3:DST8.title: Your receivers are solid. Your defense is not.
pos:WR3:DST8.text: Wide receiver production ranks third in the league. Defense ranks dead last. That's the easiest spot to upgrade off the waiver wire.
